page: Google Cloud Platform a4x-maxgpu-4g-metal is a bare-metal, accelerator-optimized server designed for intensive computational workloads. It is powered by 144 dedicated vCPUs based on the arm64 CPU architecture. The system features 960.0 GB of system memory, providing approximately 6.67 GB of RAM per core.

The server is equipped with four NVIDIA GB300 GPUs from the Blackwell family, delivering a combined total of 1116 GB of VRAM. For high-speed local data access, the instance includes 12885 GB of local NVMe SSD storage. It does not include any complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Given its high-density hardware profile, which integrates massive GPU memory, dedicated arm64 processing cores, and substantial local NVMe storage, this server represents a high-resource tier optimized for extreme parallel processing. It is designed for workloads such as large language model training, complex data science jobs, high-performance computing, and large-scale AI inference.
